page.notes: Right edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Several words are read from a small, low-contrast scan. The paragraph breaks before "Amitæ", "Matertera" and "Ad mulierem" are marked by large decorative initials, and I took them as paragraph starts. The catchword is partly cut off, so it is doubtful. "Nouercæ" and "Filiæ" are read from the scan and may be spelled differently in print. Line-end breaks in "na-turam" and "naturam" show no printed hyphen, so they are written whole.
